{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash
# Flux batch script converted from Slurm

# NOTE:
#   Slurm uses a job array (--array=0-39). Flux job arrays are not available as a
#   universally portable batch-script directive.
#
# Run with:
#   flux batch <this_script> -- <TASK_ID>
# where <TASK_ID> is 0..39.

# Slurm resources:
#   -A phillipslab
#   --partition=phillips
#   --job-name=filt1
#   --time=00:240:00
#   --nodes=1
#   --ntasks=1
#   --array=0-39
#   --cpus-per-task=4

#flux: --job-name=filt1
#flux: -N 1
#flux: -n 1
#flux: -c 4
#flux: --time-limit=240m

# Omitted Slurm option: --array=0-39
# Flux job arrays are not available as a universally portable batch-script directive.
# Performance implication: you must submit multiple jobs manually (or loop), increasing scheduler overhead and potentially reducing throughput.

# Omitted Slurm options: -A phillipslab (account) and --partition=phillips
# Flux accounting/project selection and queue/partition selection are site-specific; no portable equivalents.
# Performance implication: job may be charged differently, have different priority/limits, run on different nodes, or be rejected.

TASK_ID=${1:-0}

export OMP_NUM_THREADS=4

module load easybuild icc/2017.1.132-GCC-6.3.0-2.27 impi/2017.1.132 skewer

cd /projects/phillipslab/ateterina/CR_popgen/data/reads/

LISTFILES=(*.fastq)
file=${LISTFILES[$TASK_ID]}

skewer -x AGATCGGAAGAG -t 4 -q 20 -l 36 -d 0.1 -r 0.1 -o ${file/_1.fastq/.tr1} $file ${file/_1.fastq/_2.fastq}

mv ${file/_1.fastq/.tr1-trimmed-pair1.fastq} ${file/_1.fastq/_fp1.ok.fastq}
mv ${file/_1.fastq/.tr1-trimmed-pair2.fastq} ${file/_1.fastq/_fp2.ok.fastq}
"
}
